trash.intro.en: Deleted items wait here for 30 days, then they're gone for good. The trash costs nothing; restoring an item charges the storage for the days it spent here, and restoring on the day it was deleted is free.
trash.intro.cs: Smazané položky tu čekají 30 dní, pak zmizí natrvalo. Koš nic nestojí; obnovení položky se účtuje za úložiště po dny, které tu strávila, a obnovení v den smazání je zdarma.

trash.emptyState.description.en: Deleted books, songs, playlists and episodes wait here for 30 days.
trash.emptyState.description.cs: Smazané knihy, skladby, playlisty a epizody tu čekají 30 dní.

trash.item.owner.note: Whose item this is, when it isn't yours.

trash.item.goneIn.cs: zmizí za {days, plural, one {# den} few {# dny} other {# dní}}

trash.restoreDialog.titleMany.en: Restore {count, plural, one {# item} other {# items}}?
trash.restoreDialog.titleMany.cs: Obnovit {count, plural, one {# položku} few {# položky} other {# položek}}?

trash.restoreDialog.description.en: Restoring charges {amount} — the storage for {days, plural, one {# day} other {# days}} in the trash, as if it had never been deleted.
trash.restoreDialog.description.cs: Obnovení stojí {amount} — úložiště za {days, plural, one {# den} few {# dny} other {# dní}} v koši, jako by nikdy nebylo smazáno.

trash.purgeDialog.description.en: It's removed now instead of in 30 days. This can't be undone.
trash.purgeDialog.description.cs: Odstraní se hned, ne až za 30 dní. Nelze to vrátit.
